all_state_independent_audit.limitations: Rigid-body net force/moment and fresh actual old-state Panda-step residuals are reconstructed independently without importing the coupled rigid solver. Rigidity is checked against an independent finite-rotation map, and joint integration/kinematics/contact forces use actual saved states. An explicitly allowed failed prefix is not a complete history. This does not establish physical contact/space/time convergence, native load-model accuracy or verified warmed cost.
